page.overview:
What is 6th Black Crusade?

During this campaign, Abaddon visited his wrath upon the treacherous warband of Chaos Space Marines known as the Sons of the Eye.

The Sons of the Eye were a splinter warband of the Black Legion, founded and commanded by the Chaos Lord Drecarth the Sightless, the Blind Butcher of Irridous VII.

Drecarth was a former battle-brother of the Sons of Horus who had fought alongside Abaddon during the Great Crusade and the Horus Heresy that followed.

Always jealous of the Primarch Horus' favour for the Despoiler, the Sons of the Eye considered Abaddon a usurper when he took command of the XVI Legion following the Slave Wars in the Eye of Terror.
